prompts.question: Does the trading or freight forwarding firm hold an active Customs Broker Licence issued by the Australian Border Force under Part XI of the Customs Act 1901?
prompts.why_it_matters: Acting as a commercial customs broker or lodging import/export declarations through the Integrated Cargo System (ICS) without an active ABF license is a federal offense under Australian customs law.
prompts.how_to_query: Search ABF published register of Licensed Customs Brokers (Corporate and Nominee) by entity name {company}
prompts.found_when: The company acts as a customs clearance agent but lacks an active ABF corporate customs broker licence
prompts.not_found_when: The entity's corporate customs broker licence is verified active on official ABF lists
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ABF portal register downloads are unavailable

tested.result: International freight forwarding and customs clearance operated under authorized ABF broker standards
Cross-border trading shipments processed in compliance with ABF clearance rules
Fresh produce export logistics conform to Australian customs clearance regulations
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Border Force (ABF)

prompts.question: Does the import-export entity falsely claim Australian Trusted Trader (ATT) accreditation when it is not certified by the Australian Border Force?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely displaying Australian Trusted Trader logos breaches Australian Border Force trade integrity standards and exposes the firm to sanctions under the Customs Act.
prompts.how_to_query: Check the official Australian Trusted Trader public register on abf.gov.au for {company}
prompts.found_when: The firm displays the ATT trustmark on its website but is absent from the certified ATT directory
prompts.not_found_when: The entity is confirmed as an active accredited Australian Trusted Trader partner
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ABF ATT register portal is offline

tested.result: Commercial freight services marketed without uncertified Australian Trusted Trader claims
Trading capabilities accurately described without false government trade trustmarks
Global fresh produce supply chain operations compliant with standard export certification
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Border Force (Australian Trusted Trader)

prompts.question: Does the company hold valid Biosecurity Approved Arrangements (AA) or required BICON import permits for importing biological, animal, or agricultural goods?
prompts.why_it_matters: Importing regulated agricultural or biological goods without valid DAFF biosecurity clearance incurs immediate cargo quarantine, destruction, and federal biosecurity penalties.

source.name: Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF)

prompts.how_to_query: Check DAFF Biosecurity Import Conditions (BICON) database and Approved Arrangements register for {company}
prompts.found_when: An importer of food or plant commodities operates quarantine premises without active DAFF Approved Arrangement status
prompts.not_found_when: The company holds valid DAFF import permits and registered biosecurity arrangement credentials
prompts.couldnt_check_when: DAFF BICON system is down for technical updates

tested.result: General manufactured cargo import workflows comply with non-biosecurity customs pathways
Consumer trade goods handled under standard non-perishable documentation
Export phytosanitary inspection certificates verified for international fresh fruit trade
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF)

prompts.question: Does the importing entity claim approval under the ATO Deferred GST Scheme without meeting ongoing monthly business activity statement (BAS) compliance?
prompts.why_it_matters: Ineligible or revoked Deferred GST participation results in surprise upfront GST liabilities and cargo release holds at Australian container terminals.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify Deferred GST Scheme (DGST) eligibility status through Integrated Cargo System (ICS) lodgment profiles
prompts.found_when: The importer claims deferred GST entry at the border while removed from the ATO DGST scheme for non-compliance
prompts.not_found_when: The importer maintains active DGST approval and lodges monthly electronic BAS on time
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ATO or ABF cargo interface is undergoing maintenance

tested.result: Freight forwarding invoicing reflects compliant GST collection and customs duty handling
GST registered trading entity follows standard border taxation schedules
Export operations qualify for GST-free zero-rated international export supplies
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Taxation Office (Deferred GST Scheme)

prompts.question: Are the export products, corporate address, and international market capabilities listed in Austrade trade databases accurate and aligned with the company's current operations?
prompts.why_it_matters: Inaccurate directory records in official Austrade channels generate dead inquiries, failed trade lead matching, and missed federal export grant opportunities.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Austrade's Australian Suppliers and Exporters directories by company name {company}
prompts.found_when: The Austrade supplier listing features disconnected phone numbers, defunct addresses, or outdated commodity codes
prompts.not_found_when: Directory details match current operating premises, export product range, and corporate website
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Austrade supplier directory search is temporarily down

tested.result: Operating address and Melbourne logistics contacts verified accurate on public trade registers
Corporate headquarters in Sydney verified up to date
Export product listings and international market destinations accurately reflected
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Trade and Investment Commission (Austrade)
